verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform. A permissioned, diligence-ready data room with cap table views is an equity-management or virtual-data-room capability, which is a category error for this kind of product. Shared workspaces and team collaboration are generic features, not a cap-table data room, and the evidence never shows Claude shipping one.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
